annotations.title: Get BotInfo's sourced evidence on a robot

description: Get the findings of BotInfo's public evidence page on a robot model: what the maker's own spec sheets, SDK code, CVE records, government rules and purchase records show, each finding with its source URLs (code pinned to a commit), the date it was read, and a grade (checked = reopened by a second reviewer; our data; our inference). Use it when someone is deciding whether to buy, run or build on a robot and needs dated, citable facts rather than marketing claims. Text is quoted verbatim from the public page (CC BY 4.0, credit BotInfo.ai with the page link). If no page exists for the model, the reply lists the robots that have one.
name: robot_evidence
